steps.code:
# Parse all notes into structured data
import re

parsed_notes = []
for note in notes_data:
    title = note['title']
    # Extract date from title like "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not m:
        print("No date found in title:", title)
        continue
    date = m.group(1)
    content = note['content']
    habits = []
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = parts[0].strip()
            value = parts[1].strip().lower()
            if value not in ('yes', 'no'):
                print("Unexpected value:", value, "in note", date)
            habits.append((habit, value))
    parsed_notes.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits})

# Print first and last to verify
print("First:", parsed_notes[0])
print("Last:", parsed_notes[-1])
print("Number of notes:", len(parsed_notes))
